settings.content: Shared payment icons bar for the product page, cart page and cart drawer. On the product page, add the "SC – Payment icons bar" block to place it (e.g. below Add to cart).

settings.label: Show payment icons bar
settings.info: Master switch for every placement. Use it for A/B tests.

settings.label: Keep hidden markup for A/B testing
settings.info: When the bar is switched off it is still output but hidden. Reveal it in a test variant with the CSS: sc-pay-bar.sc-pay-bar[data-sc-ab-hidden] { display: block !important; }

settings.label: Single swipeable row on mobile
settings.info: Off = icons wrap onto new lines on small screens.

settings.label: Maximum icons shown
settings.info: Recommended: 6 or fewer for a clean single row.

settings.label: Only show methods enabled in store
settings.info: Hides ticked methods that are not active in Settings → Payments.

settings.label: TWINT
settings.info: Only where TWINT is supported (Switzerland).

settings.label: Display on cart and cart drawer
Custom provider logo
settings.info: Optional. Replaces the built-in Klarna / PayPal logo.

settings.label: Message
settings.info: [amount] = price (PDP) or cart total (cart) divided by the number of instalments. [count] = number of instalments.

settings.content: Free gift progress bar for the cart page and the cart drawer. Customers see how much more they need to spend to unlock a free gift. Setup guide: docs/sc-cart-free-gift-progress-setup.md

settings.label: Enable free gift
settings.info: Master switch for the cart page and cart drawer. Use it for A/B tests.

settings.label: Show in cart drawer
settings.info: Needs Cart type: Drawer (Theme settings → Cart).

settings.label: Hide when the cart is empty
Hide when the gift is sold out
Free gift minimum amount
settings.info: In your store's default currency, e.g. 100 = 100.00. Converted automatically for other markets.

settings.label: Amount that counts towards the minimum
settings.info: The gift's own value never counts towards the minimum.

settings.label: Gift pricing
settings.info: Selecting a product does not make it free. Use a 0.00 gift product (tag it hidden) or a Shopify automatic discount.

settings.label: Auto add
settings.info: Adds the gift as soon as the minimum is reached. When off, customers get an "Add free gift" button.

settings.label: If the customer removes the auto-added gift
Remove gift when cart drops below minimum
settings.info: Recommended. If off, a customer could keep a free gift without reaching the minimum.

settings.label: Round converted minimum up to a whole number
settings.info: Only for other currencies, e.g. 108.43 becomes 109.00.

settings.label: After the gift is added or removed
Progress bar gift icon (SVG code)
settings.info: Used when Icon is "Custom SVG code". Only shapes are kept; scripts, links and styles are removed for safety.

settings.label: Custom icon image
settings.info: Used when Icon is "Custom image".

settings.content: Placeholders: [amount] = amount still needed, [threshold] = minimum amount, [gift] = gift product name.

settings.label: Locked message
settings.default: Add [amount] more to unlock your free gift!

settings.label: Unlocked message
settings.default: Congratulations! You've unlocked your free gift!

settings.label: Gift added message
settings.default: Your free gift has been added to your cart.

settings.label: Gift removed message
settings.default: Your free gift was removed because your cart is below [threshold].

settings.label: Gift sold out message
settings.default: The free gift is currently out of stock.

settings.label: Error message
settings.default: We couldn't add your free gift. Please try again.

settings.label: Custom gift image
settings.info: Optional. Defaults to the gift product image.

settings.label: Show crossed-out gift value
settings.info: Automatic discount: shows the product price. 0.00 product: shows its compare-at price, if set.
